summary: TerraTrio is an interactive web application that helps with finding analogs between Earth, Mars and the Moon. The app provides detailed descriptions of every location that might help with setting up future lunar bases and Martian expeditions. It allows the user to choose from various parameters and use them to identify the best locations for scientific reaserch. In order to find the best places the app allows the user to combine several parameters. Tech and scientific communities will have an easy to use, fast and precise tool with recent data for everyday reaserch.
details:
TerraTrio is an interactive 3D planetary exploration web application that allows users to seamlessly navigate and analyze geographic data across Earth, Mars, and the Moon.

The App renders 3D maps of each celestial body. Users can rotate, zoom and pause/resume planetary rotation. The app translates 3D screen clicks into precise geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) using custom conversion formulas. Users can double-click the surface or use a right-sidebar form to pin custom points, and single-click existing markers to trigger info cards and detailed data modal windows. It also features an interactive left-sidebar catalog with color-coded subcategories.

The App was made with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. To render 3D maps we used an JS library Three.js. The app is hosted by GitHub.

The main benefits are:

1. Accessibility: Fully client-side and hosted statically, requiring no complex server setup or installations—users can access it instantly via any modern web browser.

2. Versatility & Customization: Allows users to not only view preset geological landmarks and exploration sites (such as Olympus Mons or the Apollo 11 landing site) but also create, save, and delete their own custom coordinate points.

3. Cross-Body Comparison: Enables direct exploration of planetary analogues by switching effortlessly between Earth, Mars, and the Moon within a unified interface.

By presenting complex 3D geographic data in an intuitive, and educational interface, TerraTrio provides a digital tool for students, space enthusiasts, and researchers to visualize terrain types, mission sites, and geological features across multiple worlds.

TerraTrio is creative, because rather than relying on heavy desktop, it implements custom geometric math, dynamic texture grids and multi layered UI components.

During development we considered factors such as:

1. Geographic Accuracy - The grid allows us to ensure that real world coordinates allight almost perfectly with the visual features on our 3D model.

2. User Experience - Designing clean, non-intrusive sidebars, customized color-coded text for subcategories, and responsive buttons (such as the rotation pause/resume toggle with fixed sizing to prevent layout shifting).

3. Performance & Navigation Limits: Setting strict camera boundary constraints to prevent users from clipping through the interior of the sphere while keeping navigation smooth and intuitive.
